messages:
nora (sales): Heads-up: Oakmont signed LOI — they want a 2-week POC. Primary ask: onboard their custom 30B variant with KV-cache + 4-bit quant. @samir can you own model ingest and compatibility checks?

samir (se): Yup, I can take it. Quick Q: tokenizer type and where the weights live? If HF-compatible we should be fast.

lee (oakmont-cust): Uploaded bundle to s3://oakmont-poc/oak-30b-v1.tar.gz — tokenizer is standard BPE, config.json included.

samir (se): Thanks. Two early checks: rmsnorm vs layernorm, and attention KV layout (contiguous vs interleaved). If standard we'll run ingest on Dedicated staging. ETA ~48h for compatibility run.

jin (eng-runtime): Runtime notes: for 4-bit quant we have q4m path available but perf varies. Also for long-context we need +20% KV memory headroom. Can you confirm target context length?

lee (oakmont-cust): Targets: 8k for the POC, hope to test 16k later. BYOK for keys is required.

priya (security): On our side: we need the security questionnaire answered and org-level entitlements for BYOK/KMS. I'll send the redacted questionnaire and KMS onboarding checklist. Oakmont must provide IAM contacts and compliance attestation.

nora (sales): Pricing note from customer: ~3M tokens/month with target unit cost < $0.0008/token. @samir @jin any levers to hit that?

samir (se): We can apply prefix caching + batching (batch_window=3) and prefer q4m. That combo usually saves ~25–35%. Also recommend reserved capacity for predictable throughput. We'll include those options in SOW.

lee (oakmont-cust): Also want to confirm: if q4 variants degrade quality, can we fallback to FP16 baseline automatically?

samir (se): Yes — runtime supports canary/A-B rollouts and automatic fallback to pinned baseline model. We'll set up canary with a 10% traffic window and evaluation prompts.

deploy-bot: deploy started: model-compat-check on staging (job 7242)

samir (se): Quick run results: tokenizer OK, rmsnorm present, attention parity mostly OK. Found a rotary embedding packing mismatch — fixed via adapter patch. Full ingest running, ETA ~12h.

priya (security): I'll also flag that BYOK for Private requires legal LOA + KMS config; sending template now.

nora (sales): Action items: 1) Samir finish ingest + post perf/cost numbers here. 2) Priya send questionnaire + KMS checklist. 3) Nora to draft SOW/pricing. Target: kickoff call Friday.

lee (oakmont-cust): Friday works. Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

samir (se): Ingest done. Short summary: p95 latency ~280ms @ 8k context on Dedicated staging; estimated token cost ~$0.00065/token using q4m + caching. Logs and perf traces at /common/pocs/oakmont/7242.

nora (sales): :rocket: Great — I'll start SOW draft with the q4m + reserved capacity option. Priya, ping me when questionnaire is sent so I can attach to contract.

priya (security): Sent questionnaire and KMS checklist to lee@oakmont via secure link.

lee (oakmont-cust): Got it, thanks everyone. Looking forward to the Friday kickoff.

samir (se): I'll post final ingest artifacts and the canary config later today.

nora (sales): Perfect — closing loop here.
